what: Twelve small thumbnails stand in one row with only the center cell widened to 432px (.64s), shifting one cell every 5 seconds. The side progress bar fills over 5 seconds, and the title slides 10px left (.22s) then returns to place from 7px right at 1.04× horizontal scale in 1.22s (the more link .2s later)

options.count: Actual number of slides used for numbering (excluding clones made for looping), default slide count
options.[data-fx-part=track]: swiper panel (child, required) — data-title·data-link on each slide
options.[data-fx-part=prev·next·bar·num·title·mo: Prev/next buttons, progress bar, current number, title, and More link (only when present)
